detailsAndRegistration.formTitle: Join Us for Śrī Kṛṣṇa Janmāṣṭamī !
detailsAndRegistration.shimmerText: Hare Kṛṣṇa, Hare Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa, Hare Hare, Hare Rāma, Hare Rāma, Rāma Rāma, Hare Hare

videoHighlights.title: Divine Inspiration
videoHighlights.subtitle: Watch and immerse yourself in the glories of Lord Krishna
videoHighlights.video1Subtitle: Divine lecture on Sri Krishna's appearance

activities.title: Claim Your Free Pass to a Divine Celebration
activities.subtitle: Immerse yourself in a variety of spiritual and cultural activities. Here’s a glimpse of what awaits you at <1>Śrī Kṛṣṇa Janmāṣṭamī 2025</1>.

dialog.title: Thank you for registering!
dialog.subtitle: Your presence is a gift. You can now share the joy or consider sponsoring this divine event.

sponsorship.title: Sponsorship Opportunities
sponsorship.subtitle: Seize this golden opportunity to render direct service to Lord Krishna on His divine appearance day and receive unlimited blessings.
sponsorship.cantAttendTitle: Can't Attend? You Can Still Receive Blessings!
sponsorship.cantAttendBody: We'll miss you at the divine festival and the delicious free prasadam buffet! Though you can't be here in person, your devotion can still reach Lord Krishna through a heartfelt seva sponsorship.
sponsorship.sincereHeart: Even the smallest contribution made with a sincere heart is a great service.

kalasa.title: Kalasa Abhisekam Seva
kalasa.description: Participate in the sacred bathing ceremony of the Lord. Your contribution helps procure auspicious items for the abhishekam, bringing immense spiritual benefit.

gita.title: Bhagavad Gītā seva
gita.description: Sponsor the distribution of Bhagavad-gita, the essence of all Vedic knowledge. This is the highest form of charity, giving spiritual enlightenment to others.

milk.title: Milk Abhishekam Seva
milk.description: Offer a loving milk bath to the deities. This seva is a beautiful expression of devotion and helps in the grand worship of the Lord on His appearance day.

archana.title: Archana seva
archana.description: Contribute towards the articles of worship, such as flowers, incense, lamps, and other paraphernalia required for the daily archana (worship) of the deities.

annadanam.title: Annadanam seva
annadanam.description: Sponsor the distribution of delicious Krishna prasadam to all the devotees and visitors. There is no greater service than feeding the Lord's devotees.

mainAltar.description: Experience the heart of the festival with sacred rituals and worship.

abhishekam.title: Abhishekam
abhishekam.description: Elaborate ritualistic bathing of Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa with milk, yogurt, ghee, honey, fruit juices, and sacred waters, amidst Vedic mantras.

arati.title: Arati Sessions
arati.description: Multiple arati ceremonies throughout the day, from Mangal Arati to Shayana Arati.

puja.title: Pūjā Offerings
puja.description: An opportunity for devotees to make special offerings to the Deities.

darshan.title: Special Darshan
darshan.description: Witness the divine beauty of Radha Krishna in a special dress on Their special day.

cultural.description: Nourish your soul with enchanting performances and deep spiritual wisdom.

performances.title: Cultural Performances & Drama
performances.description: Dramas depicting Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, classical Indian dances, and devotional songs.

kirtan.title: Soulful Harināma Kīrtan
kirtan.description: Continuous congregational chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa Mahamantra.

discourses.title: Spiritual Discourses
discourses.description: Lectures on the significance of Janmāṣṭamī and the philosophy of the Bhagavad Gita.

fancyDress.title: Divine Fancy Dress show
fancyDress.description: A delightful competition for children dressed as characters from Kṛṣṇa's pastimes.

prasadam.category: Prasādam Stalls for your body and soul
prasadam.description: Try to our different Prasadam stalls that nourishes your body and soul.

mahaprasadam.title: Mahaprasadam & Bakery Stall
mahaprasadam.description: Enjoy delicious, pure Prasadam varieties, cakes, and biscuits prepared in the temple.

paniPuri.title: Pani Puri Stall
paniPuri.description: Enjoy the popular and savory Indian street Prasadam, prepared freshly for you.

stalls.description: Explore spiritual literature and find devotional items to take home.

books.title: Spiritual Books
books.description: A wide range of spiritual books, including Bhagavad Gita, Srimad Bhagavatam, and other Vedic literatures.

sponsorship.title: Bhagavad Gita Sponsorship
sponsorship.description: A dedicated stall to learn about and participate in the Gita distribution program.

souvenirs.title: Devotional Souvenirs
souvenirs.description: Find deities, photos and other devotional items.

info.title: Reception & Info Desk
info.description: Reception and information stall at your service

outreach.description: Learn about our community projects and how you can get involved.

temple.title: Temple Building Project Showcase
temple.description: Explore the Puducherry's tallest temple's project and progress. You can be part of it too.

school.title: Bhakta Prahlad Vedic School
school.description: Information about the Vedic school's curriculum, admissions, and activities.

gaushala.title: Gokulam Gaushala (Cow Protection)
gaushala.description: Learn about our cow protection initiatives and how to support them.

foodForLife.title: Food for Life
foodForLife.description: Participate in our daily Prasadam distribution program to distribute free, sanctified vegetarian meals to the needy and poor.
